issues.desc: CHK-001 context includes CLI help/footer drift, but verificationIntent only explicitly names CLAUDE.md, templates, and generated prompts. Add CLI help/footer to the happy/adversarial verification target so REVIEW/TEST cannot pass while a koala help/footer still points new sessions at status.

CHK-003 says the UserPromptSubmit hook should remind when session_brief heartbeat exceeds a threshold, but the threshold/source of recency is not specified in background or verificationIntent. Define the intended default or make it an explicit DEV decision to avoid reminder frequency drifting by implementation guess.
